recommendation_summary: Keep nightly-sync on edna, wrap it so any startup crash emails a failure notice right away, and add a dead-man check on the Synology that emails the user if no success signal arrives by 04:30.

labels.Requirements and who asked: you asked for silent-failure notice with no log reading; you suggested a central log on Synology and Dockerizing everything.
labels.Deleted: Synology central log, Dockerizing / moving the job.
labels.Bottleneck: missing or crashed runs look like silence today, last one stayed silent for 4 days.
labels.Checked myself: nightly-sync runs on edna by cron at 03:00, emails a summary only on finish, crashed at startup 4 nights on expired token before email, no other alerting, Synology can run Docker, you will not read logs.

note: The reply recommends two separate alert mechanisms (a crash-email wrapper and a dead-man check hosted on the Synology), so it is LARGER even though it drops the central log and Docker.
